 Is the Stock Market Open on Veterans Day? Here’s the Rest of the Year’s Trading Holiday Schedule
 David Marino-Nachison 2026년 11월 9일 월 오후 7:05 UTC 0 American cities often observe Veterans Day with parades, as New York City did last year.Credit: Stephani Spindel / VIEWpress Traders will get a partial break Wednesday for Veterans Day.
 Bond markets will be closed on Wednesday, Nov. 11, in observance of the holiday, which honors those who have served in the U.S. armed forces. (Memorial Day honors those who died while serving.) Stock markets will remain open.
 The next full trading holiday will be on Thursday, Nov. 26, with stock and bond markets closed for Thanksgiving. The stock market will close at 1 p.m. ET on Friday, Nov. 27, while bond markets will close at 2 p.m. that day.
 Advertisement
 Both stock and bond markets will close for Christmas on Friday, Dec. 25. The stock market will close at 1 p.m. ET on Thursday, Dec. 24, for Christmas Eve, while bond markets will close at 2 p.m.
 Stock and bond markets will also close for New Year’s Day on Friday, Jan. 1. Bond markets will close at 2 p.m. ET on Thursday, Dec. 31, for New Year’s Eve.
